access.notes: Python package for atomic structure manipulation and DFT code interfaces.

resources.name: Open-source DFT code (GPAW or Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Either code can be used to perform PBE+U calculations; GPAW with PAW setups is recommended.
Standard PBE pseudopotential libraries, publicly available.

Hexagonal lattice with a ≈7.13 Å, triazine units with C–Nin bond 1.33 Å and C–Nlink bond 1.46 Å, as reported in literature (e.g., Kroke et al. Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2014, 53, 11134). The agent constructs the unit cell from these known values.
